sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
mboetger left three inline comments on [#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561) a few minutes before he approved it ("Overall LGTM."). Neither issue changes how the code behaves. Pushing a fix to the PR branch now would dismiss all three approvals, rerun about an hour of presubmits, and delay the 3.50/3.51 cherry-picks.

**My view of each comment:**

- **Comment 1** ([r4606831206](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206), "nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists"): **Accept, in a follow-up PR.** `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` replaces the try/catch with one line and should behave the same. It is a style change only, so it is not worth new approvals and presubmits.
- **Comments 2–3** ([r4606860038](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038), adb installs fine; rejected only over a build that has a versionCode): **He's right, and the KDoc is wrong.** An APK with no `versionCode` installs fresh with adb. It fails on Play upload and when installed as an update over a build that has a versionCode. The decision still holds: suggesting `force-version-code-ignoring-abi` for this error would still be wrong, because those APKs can't ship or update an existing install. Only the stated reason needs to be reworded. It is a code comment, so the fix doesn't need to go to the release branches.

**One thing I haven't confirmed yet:** whether the same false claim ("Android refuses to install") also appears in the error string users see, or in the PR description. matt561 is checking (brief below), and I'll check the diff myself. If the user-facing string does repeat it, I'll come back and recommend fixing it before merge. Otherwise we would ship wrong guidance to two release branches.

**Decision 1: how to handle these comments**
- **1a (recommended):** Merge #196561 as it is now. matt561 puts both fixes in a follow-up PR on main, which needs no cherry-pick. This keeps the approvals and the cherry-pick timing. It applies only if the user-facing string is clean.
- **1b:** Push both fixes to #196561 now. This dismisses all three approvals, adds about an hour of presubmits plus three new approvals, and delays both cherry-picks. It is clean history, but costly for a comment fix and a nit.

I've drafted replies for you to post, because mboetger is a human reviewer and I won't post to him myself:

> **r4606831206:** Good call, `toBigIntegerOrNull()` is cleaner. I'll switch to it in a follow-up so this can land and be cherry-picked to 3.50/3.51 without re-running review.

> **r4606860038:** You're right. An APK without a versionCode installs fresh with adb. It fails on Play upload and when installed over a build that has a versionCode. I'll fix the KDoc in the same follow-up. The conclusion stays the same: the flag isn't a useful suggestion for this error, because those APKs can't ship or update an existing install.

Before you add `autosubmit`, I'll re-query the PR's reviews, threads and CI so the state is current.

Reply "go 1a" to post the replies, merge as is, and have matt561 open the follow-up after #196561 lands. Or reply "go 1b" to push the fixes into #196561 now.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
<WORKER-BRIEF>

Task for matt561: prepare a local follow-up for flutter/flutter#196561 ("Fix --split-per-abi versionCode when android {} omits versionCode"). **Do not push anything to `vcfix-manifest-fallback`.** All three reviewers have approved and CI is green. A push would dismiss the approvals and rerun about an hour of presubmits before the 3.50/3.51 cherry-picks.

The reviewer is mboetger (a human), and these are his comments in full:

Comment 1, `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 113, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206:
> nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

The comment is on:
```kotlin
val versionCode =
    try {
        BigInteger(value)
    } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
        null
    }
```

Comments 2 and 3, one thread on `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt` line 152, https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038:
> I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

The thread is on the KDoc of `errorMessage(variantName, reason)`. That KDoc says that when the manifest has no positive `versionCode`, `force-version-code-ignoring-abi` "builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which Android refuses to install."

Steps:
1. Create a local branch `vcfix-review-followup` from `f3d2ab1fd3b` (the head of `vcfix-manifest-fallback`).
2. **Check first, before you edit:** search the user-facing error string built by `errorMessage`, the PR description, the tests, and any docs for the same "refuses to install" claim. Report every occurrence with file and line, and say which ones a user would see. If the user-facing string makes the claim, stop after this step and report to me before changing anything.
3. If you have an emulator, check the claim yourself. Build split-per-abi APKs with `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` from a manifest with no versionCode. Then (a) `adb install` it on a clean device, and (b) `adb install -r` it over an installed build that has a versionCode. Record the exact adb output for each, for example `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE`. If you can't run an emulator, say so. Don't guess.
4. Rewrite the KDoc so it matches what is true: the APK installs fresh, but Play rejects it and it can't be installed as an update over a build that has a versionCode. Keep the sentence about AGP failing on a value that is not a decimal integer only if you confirm it. Say whether you still agree that the error should not suggest the flag, and why.
5. Replace the try/catch with `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()`. Check that it behaves the same as `BigInteger(String)` for these inputs: `"5"`, `"+5"`, `"-5"`, `"0"`, `""`, `" 5"`, `"5 "`, `"0x10"`, `"1e3"`, a number larger than Long, and non-ASCII digits such as `"١٢"`. Add unit tests if the existing ones don't cover these inputs. Report any input where the two differ.
6. Run the unit tests for this helper and any Gradle/Kotlin lint or analysis the PR's CI runs. Report the exact commands and results.
7. Commit locally. Don't push and don't open a PR until I tell you, which will be after #196561 merges. When I do, push only to the `reidbaker-agent` fork and open the PR against `main`.
8. Don't reply on GitHub. mboetger is a human reviewer, and reidbaker posts those replies.

Report back with: the results of step 2, the adb output (or why you couldn't get it), the full diff, the test commands and results, and any cases where the two parsers differ.
